audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer credits Ryze with a 'passive shield' in three places (whys[6], spikes[2], spikes[3], late, wants.foe[1]) and tells you to 'dodge' Rune Prison.
audit.why: Riot's text for Arcane Mastery gives bonus damage from Bonus Mana and mana from AP — no shield anywhere in the kit. Rune Prison is a targeted cage (615 range) that always lands; the variable is Spell Flux, which upgrades the slow into a root. Overload has a flat 5s cooldown and is reset by his other basic abilities, which is the actual source of his poke pressure.
audit.corrected: Shield references removed; Rune Prison restated as always landing but only rooting through Spell Flux; Overload's reset chain named as the damage engine and Rune Prison's 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s cooldown used as the step-up window.

edits.before: Ryze's Overload (Q) reset off Rune Prison (W) root gives him rapid poke, but his root has a tell; if he lands W on you he chains a full Q rotation, so dodge the point-blank W and his damage falls off a cliff.
edits.after: Ryze's Overload (Q) resets off every W and E, so his poke is relentless — but Rune Prison only roots through Spell Flux. Deny the E orb and his W is a bare slow, and his chain damage falls off a cliff.

edits.before: Ryze's first mana item is a huge power spike: his Q spam becomes a wall of damage and his shield-and-flux burst starts to out-DPS your assassin window, so all-in only when W is down.
edits.after: Ryze's first mana item is a huge power spike: Overload's 5s cooldown resets off every W and E, and Flux-amped Q burst out-DPSes your blink window, so all-in only while Rune Prison is down.

edits.before: Late Ryze out-scales you hard — mana-stacked Q-E flux detonations and his passive shield make him a raid boss who can root and kite you before you close, so the lane tilts to him with items.
edits.after: Late Ryze out-scales you hard — mana-stacked Q-E Flux detonations and a 9-second Rune Prison root make him a kiter who peels you off before you close, so the lane tilts to him with items.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 stay even and revolve around his W. If you dodge Rune Prison his combo fizzles and you can Q-slow, E-blink in, and threaten burst; if you eat the root he chains Q-E-flux for heavy damage. Play around that one button — your mobility lets you bait it. His level-6 R is a map tool, so it doesn't shift the duel.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 stay even and revolve around his W. Rune Prison is targeted and always lands, but it only roots if Spell Flux is on you — otherwise it is a slow, so step in on its 10-second cooldown and threaten burst. His level-6 R is a map tool, so it doesn't shift the duel.

edits.before: After his first mana item the matchup tips to Ryze and only worsens. Stacked mana turns his Q into relentless AoE damage, his passive shield blunts your all-in, and his root plus kite keeps you off him before your W-and-E burst can land. This is a scaling loss — press your even early-mid windows hard and get help before his items come online.
edits.after: After his first mana item the matchup tips to Ryze and only worsens. Stacked mana turns his Q into relentless AoE damage, Spell Flux upgrades his targeted W into a root you cannot sidestep, and that kite keeps you off him before your W-and-E burst can land. This is a scaling loss — press your even early-mid windows hard and get help before his items come online.
